<div class="card-body">
'''Restraining Bolt''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">行動規制ボルト</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の位置カード上の好きなドロイドに配備する。そのドロイドは移動できず、カードルールを使用できない。同じ位置に別のドロイドがいれば、自分の支配フェイズに行動規制ボルトを（コストなしで）そのドロイドへ移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Restraining-Bolt-SWCA-100708.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ドロイドの行動を制限し、命令に従わせるためのボルト。体表に露出する専用ソケットに接着する。"コーラー"による遠隔操作が可能。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Restraining Bolt.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any droid you choose at any location card. That droid cannot move or use its card rules. If another droid is at the same location, you may move the Restraining Bolt to that droid during your control phase at no cost.

'''Lore:'''
A bolt that limits a droid’s actions and makes it obey orders. It attaches to a dedicated socket exposed on the droid’s body. A “caller” can control it remotely.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Transfer is during 支配フェイズ (control phase), not the deploy phase, and is 移動 at コストなしで.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Restraining Bolt]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
